security.scope: One original teaching guest or deterministic translation-cache model; synthetic markers only.
security.target: Original learner two-CPU address-space implementation with one deliberately premature frame-reuse path
security.environment: Disposable emulator guest with its own synthetic physical frames, or a clearly labeled deterministic cache model
security.attacker_capabilities: A teaching user task can repeatedly access its formerly mapped virtual address while the harness delays one CPU invalidation; it cannot target host memory or external systems.
security.isolation: Fresh VM, no host-disk/network/device passthrough, bounded execution and synthetic OLD/NEW markers; stop and discard the guest after each case.
security.defect: Reusing a physical frame while another CPU retains authority through a stale translation violates revocation and object isolation.
security.exposing_transition: Cache VA→A on CPU1, revoke its PTE on CPU0, withhold CPU1 invalidation, prematurely repurpose A, then access the old VA.
security.exploitability_limits: Requires a still-usable cached mapping, actual or modeled missing invalidation and premature reuse. A model violation is not hardware evidence; a crash or stale marker does not demonstrate arbitrary execution or privilege escalation.
security.success_condition: Only the original teaching target observes or modifies the synthetic NEW object through the revoked OLD mapping.
security.repair: Complete appropriate invalidation on every relevant CPU before reuse, with address-space membership, generation and acknowledgement ordering; retain frames on timeout.
security.regression: Compare flawed and repaired paths; delay one CPU, inject stale/duplicate acknowledgements, timeout, CPU membership changes and permission-revocation variants. The repaired target must never expose NEW through OLD.
security.residual_limits: Exact PCID/global-page/large-page and current CPU behavior require separate ISA inspection and target validation. The early retained IPI marker establishes only its narrower gate.
